description: This file defines the EmployeePunchInOutController class responsible for managing punch-in and punch-out operations in the orangeHRM attendance plugin. It handles HTTP requests to prepare the relevant attendance component, checking employee punch status and setting properties for the front-end Vue component.

classes.name: EmployeePunchInOutController
classes.description: Controller handling employee punch in/out logic, extending AbstractVueController, utilizing AttendanceServiceTrait.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the attendance component by determining whether the employee should punch in or out based on the latest attendance record, and sets the component's properties accordingly.
